title: Portrait and Well
author: Jonah Quintana
blurb: Gideon Ravensworth, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must return what was taken in 1974 before the last resident signs the papers.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
